name: AP Physics 1
description: Scorpio's roadmap through the eight AP Physics 1 units: ready-made, auto-graded sets in a teaching order.

sets.title: Momentum of objects and systems
sets.description: Momentum as a vector: single objects, two-object systems and changes in momentum.

sets.title: Impulse and change in momentum
sets.description: Impulse from average force and force–time graphs, and how it changes momentum.

sets.title: Conservation of momentum
sets.description: Isolated systems, explosions and pushes, and centre-of-mass motion.

sets.title: Elastic and inelastic collisions
sets.description: Sticking and bouncing collisions: momentum conserved, kinetic energy not always.

sets.title: Rotational kinematics
sets.description: Angular displacement, speed and acceleration, and linking them to linear motion.

sets.title: Torque
sets.description: Torque from force, lever arm and angle; net torque and balanced torques.

sets.title: Rotational inertia and equilibrium
sets.description: How mass distribution sets rotational inertia, and static equilibrium of rigid bodies.

sets.title: Newton's second law for rotation
sets.description: Net torque = Iα: pulleys, hanging masses and pivoted rods.

sets.title: Rotational kinetic energy and work
sets.description: Rotational kinetic energy and the work done by a torque.

sets.title: Angular momentum and angular impulse
sets.description: Angular momentum of rigid bodies and point masses, and angular impulse.

sets.title: Conservation of angular momentum
sets.description: Spinning skaters, dropped masses and tethered systems with no external torque.

sets.title: Rolling and orbits
sets.description: Rolling without slipping with energy, and angular momentum in elliptical orbits.
